name: diluvium
title: Diluvium
tagline: Lua for modern development: a 100% backward-compatible extension of Lua 5.5 with classes, lambdas, destructuring, regular expressions, string interpolation, switch, defer and secure functions, plus typed numeric arrays whose float results are bit-identical on every target -- blazing fast, under 1 MiB, and running just about everywhere. DRT, the runtime, shares this page.
